Core Active Vocabulary (10 items):

air — the gas we breathe. Example: The air is cleaner here.
water — the clear liquid we drink. Example: The water is fresh.
clean — to remove dirt, or not dirty. Example: I clean the kitchen every morning.
dirty — not clean. Example: The river is dirty.
fresh — clean and cool. Example: The water in the mountains is fresh.
polluted — dirty because of waste. Example: The river in the city is polluted.
city — a large town. Example: The city is busy.
countryside — land outside towns and cities. Example: The air is cleaner in the countryside.
healthy — good for your body. Example: A healthy environment matters.
environment — the world around us. Example: We must protect the environment.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• The air is cleaner here.
• The water is polluted.
• It is healthier than the city.

Grammar focus: Comparative adjectives.
Use comparative adjectives to compare places: The air is cleaner in the countryside. The city is noisier than the village.
